    ### >>> Self_EvolveRec-BLOCK-START: Accept the ModelView contract and resolve dynamically imported sampler bookkeeping
    def __init__(self, view, device):
        import inspect

        self.model = view
        self.device = device
        self.meta_data = view.meta_data
        self.review_data = view.review_data
        self.user_train = view.user_train
        self.module = view.model
        defining_module = inspect.getmodule(type(self.module))
        self.sampler = getattr(defining_module, "sample_batch", None)
        if self.sampler is None:
            # importlib-loaded train.py may not be registered in sys.modules.
            # Its method globals still identify the actual defining sampler.
            encoder = getattr(type(self.module), "encode_sequence", None)
            namespace = getattr(encoder, "__globals__", {})
            self.sampler = namespace.get("sample_batch")
        if self.sampler is not None and not callable(self.sampler):
            raise TypeError("The model's sample_batch attribute must be callable")
    ### <<< Self_EvolveRec-BLOCK-END
